digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and selective publication seam
propositions: Repository delegation must preserve the boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring ownership.
Publication must stage only the existing five bridge-state allowlisted files; unrelated files must not be published or destroyed.
Repository checkpoints (save/save_retired calls) must never publish independently and must leave git HEAD and index untouched while landing local files.
Unchanged passes must create no commit, and GET rotation and retired-first failure cases must preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery floors.
ADR 0099 must document repository vs publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback semantics, and explicit decisions against journal/format-migration.
Publication logic must remain in reconcile_helpers.py and must not be broadened to each repository checkpoint or invoked independently per save operation.
